lines.en: I slip along over the lava.
My legs are long, but my gait is wrong.

lines.zh: 我朝一个方向走，又改主意。
lines.en: I head one way, then change my mind.
I walk between the basalt columns.
My coat stands up in the heat.

lines.zh: 我脚下的岩浆被踩出圈。
lines.en: Lava rings where I step.
Sometimes I stop and stare.
My head is tilted at a strange angle.
I walk along the lava sea's edge.
Each step, I glance back.

lines.zh: 我的身体很暖，可里面冷。
lines.en: My body is warm; the inside is cold.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆池上慢慢趟过去。
lines.en: I wade slowly across a lava pool.
Something is leading me along.
My steps are getting quicker.
I stand still by the lava.
The tips of my coat are smoking.
I listen to the Nether's sounds.
There is something in my head.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过头去看背后。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to look behind.
My legs twitch.
Hot wind crosses my back.
I only want to stand and stare.
I blink, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得自己以前很快活。
lines.en: I remember being cheerful once.

lines.zh: 这里离我原来的家很远。
lines.en: This is far from where I used to live.
I wait for a thought to pass.
My toes grip the stone.
Smoke coils around me.
I turn my head back again.
You stand at the edge of the lava.
Are you not afraid of the heat?
I hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我也许该提醒你别靠太近。
lines.en: Perhaps I should warn you not to come closer.

lines.zh: 有人在借我的眼睛看你。
lines.en: Someone is looking at you through my eyes.
Your boots are nearly baked soft.

lines.zh: 我在这片熔岩上走了很久。
lines.en: I have walked this lava a long time.
I smell of smoke.
I turn slowly your way.
Which way are you going?
My legs are not quite obedient.

lines.zh: 你最好别站在我走的方向。
lines.en: Best not stand where I am walking.
Your breathing is very quiet.
I stand between you and the lava.
A tuft of my coat is cut away.
I sway and hold.

lines.zh: 疼，可这具身体不太在意的。
lines.en: It hurts, and this body hardly minds.
My head tilts a little more.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，踩进热灰里。
lines.en: I step back into hot ash.
A voice is cursing.
I straighten my long legs.
There is a cut on my leg.
I can still walk.
I do not want another.
That thing is warm.
I shuffle toward it.
My head is being pushed forward.
Hold it a little lower.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，不是我的食物。
lines.en: I sniff; not my food.
A smell is pulling at me.
I stretch my neck out.
This does not belong to the Nether.
I bite and catch nothing.
I should go, and I do not want to.
You bumped me and I swayed.
I am hotter than I look.

lines.zh: 这一碰把我的毛蹭到了你身上。
lines.en: That left some of my coat on you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚踩进岩浆。
lines.en: I step back into the lava.
I feel no pain from it.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，空气都在抖。
lines.en: The air shivered where we met.
My head tilted again.
Steady; the ground here is slick.
I walk off elsewhere.
Someone else lives in my body.
That is not mine to speak of.
My kind are not in this region.

lines.zh: 你问那个牵着我的人吧。
lines.en: Ask the one leading me.
I tilt my head and do not answer.
My coat is all standing up.
I cannot remember how to say it.
It is too hot by the lava.
I drag my steps away.
Let us not mention it.
I stretch my neck and take it.
It is a little hot to hold.
I drop it into the lava.

lines.zh: 它在我舌头上化了一点。
lines.en: It melted a little on my tongue.
I should not have picked this up.
A hand is pushing me to take it.
I bury it in the ash.
It jars my teeth.
I look at it and drop it.
Fine; I will keep it.
I hear something moving.
My long legs turn that way.
My head is turned that way.
I begin walking over.
Lava bubbles under my feet.
My legs are faster than I wish.
It is looking at me too.

lines.zh: 熔岩边上没有第二条路。
lines.en: There is no second path by the lava.
I hear someone laughing.
Smoke rises from my coat.
A few steps more.
I chase along the lava.
It hides behind a basalt column.
I am more used to this place than it is.
It circles; so do I.
The heat haze hides it from me.
My legs are trembling.
It backs to the lava's edge.
I stop there without moving.
I lift one leg slowly.
It is looking for a way out.
I block that side.
I thrust my head at it.
Clumsy, but strong.
My leg kicks out.
It cuts me and I barely react.
My hands are hot.
It pulls free with reddened skin.
I press forward again.
It retreats a long way.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩的边上站起来。
lines.en: I rise at the edge of the lava.
This heat used to be mine.
The tips of my coat smoke.

lines.zh: 有个东西进了我的身体。
lines.en: Something entered my body.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看见了岩浆海。
lines.en: I lift my head and see the lava sea.
My legs move first; I follow after.
I know this air.
My eyes shine in the heat.

lines.zh: 我开始走了，不是我想走。
lines.en: I start walking, and not because I wish to.
Basalt columns stand far off.

lines.zh: 我的影子在岩浆上很淡。
lines.en: My shadow is faint on the lava.
My head is wrenched to one side.
Someone is coming from that way.
I wait, and cannot help moving forward.
I hear laughter.
I take another step.

lines.zh: 火不算什么，我本来就踩着岩浆。
lines.en: Fire is nothing; I walk on lava already.

lines.zh: 我从柱子上摔下来，腿折了。
lines.en: I fall from a column and a leg folds.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，可有东西灌进来。
lines.en: There is no water, yet something floods in.
The blast throws me behind a column.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder, smoking.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我头里抓挠。
lines.en: That force claws inside my head.
Without food my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 雷落在岩浆上，我浑身一亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits the lava and I flash bright.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我四条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my legs thrash.
